0001.png.text: Devin Security keeps the findings from every scan in your organization on one page.

chunks.text: Devin Security keeps the findings from every scan

0002.png.text: It starts with a repository. Pick one, choose a scan effort, and hand it to Devin.

chunks.text: Pick one, choose a scan effort,

0004.png.text: First, Devin reads the code and drafts a threat model: what the app does, who might attack it, and what's worth protecting.

threat model: what the app does,

0005.png.text: It asks a few quick questions to sharpen that model. Answering them is optional.

0006.png.text: Then the scan runs, and Devin ranks each finding against the threat model, so the worst risks rise to the top.

0007.png.text: On the demo API, it found six issues, three of them critical.

0009.png.text: Each finding explains what's wrong, who could exploit it, and exactly how.

0010.png.text: Pick one, and click Assign to Devin.

chunks.text: Pick one, and click Assign to Devin.

0011.png.text: That starts a remediation session. Devin patches the code, writes tests for the hole, runs the test suite, and opens a pull request.
